Mariia Sergeevna Tkacheva ( Russian : Мария Сергеевна Ткачёва ; born 17 December 2001) is a Russian tennis player. Tkacheva has career-high rankings by the WTA of 319 singles and 362 in doubles, achieved November 2024 and November 2022, respectively. [ 1 ] She has won six singles and 12 doubles tournaments on the ITF Women's World Tennis Tour . [ 2 ] Tkacheva won her biggest title to date at the 2022 President's Cup , where she partnered Anastasia Zolotareva to win the doubles tournament. [ citation needed ] She made her WTA Tour debut at the 2022 Chennai Open , losing to Varvara Gracheva in the first round.
